objective: Step 1 of T-20260929-50: split the published weekend-crypto to Monday-equity effect into the Friday-close to Monday-open gap (not tradable under next-open fill) and the Monday open to close / open to next open segments (tradable), with a shuffle placebo, before spending compute on a batch.

sources.core_claim: Mourey/Shahrour/Soiman: 20 largest cryptos (~85% of cap), Bayesian/Kalman; negative weekend crypto returns significantly predict Monday equity declines, positive returns have no effect; robust across Nasdaq, Russell 2000, S&P sector indices, S&P Crypto Index; transmission strengthens after the May 2022 LUNA collapse.
sources.project_applicability: Founding claim; defines the asymmetry (W<0 only) and the post-2022-06 regime this step tests.
sources.reflection: Abstract only; no return window definition, Sharpe, rule or cost. The paper does not say whether the Monday effect is in the gap or after the open; that is exactly what step 1 measures.

sources.core_claim: Same paper (DOI 10.1016/j.frl.2025.108661), Finance Research Letters vol 86 issue PE.
sources.project_applicability: Confirms the venue and citation of the abstract read via RePEc.
sources.reflection: Full text not read; listed so that a future reader does not repeat the failed fetch.

sources.core_claim: 7-day momentum on 10 large cryptos 2020-01..2025-04 earns more on weekends than weekdays, more so for altcoins.
sources.project_applicability: Shows weekend crypto return behaviour is a distinct object; supports using the 10-coin equal-weight signal alongside BTC and ETH.
sources.reflection: Crypto-only, no equity leg, costs not quantified; weak evidence, used only to justify the EW10 variant.

sources.core_claim: Price discovery in crypto markets compares centralized and decentralized venues and spot versus futures for ETH then BTC.
sources.project_applicability: Supports treating Binance/Coinbase 15m bars as the price-discovery venues for the weekend signal.
sources.reflection: Abstract level; says nothing about equities or the Monday open.

sources.core_claim: Weekend tokenized-equity prices captured a median 92% of Monday's opening gap (81% for gaps under 0.5%) on Binance Research data to 2026-07-28; roughly 49 hours without a US reference price between CME Friday close and Sunday evening.
sources.project_applicability: Prior that weekend information is already in the Monday open, so the effect should sit in the gap; the step-1 split table tests this directly on index ETFs.
sources.reflection: One summer, thin weekend volume, wide spreads, single stocks not index ETFs; not peer reviewed.

sources.core_claim: ES futures reopen Sunday 17:00 US Central (18:00 ET) so index risk is priced before Monday 09:30 ET.
sources.project_applicability: Mechanism for why a weekend-crypto move would be priced in the equity opening print.

sources.core_claim: Alpaca overnight session runs 8:00 PM ET Sunday to 4:00 AM ET Friday via Blue Ocean ATS for all NMS securities.
sources.project_applicability: A Sunday-night fill exists at the broker but is a different fill rule from the frozen Monday-open one; recorded as an out-of-scope caveat.
sources.reflection: No liquidity or spread information; no local Sunday-night price data.

sources.core_claim: Alpaca 24/5 trading for the Trading API from 8:00 PM ET Sunday to 8:00 PM ET Friday.
sources.reflection: Marketing blog; same limits as the docs page.

sources.core_claim: Queued the direction after a gap search; notes the Alpaca crypto fee, the paper abstract and the Binance Research caution that the Monday gap already holds most weekend information.
sources.project_applicability: Source of the task and the cheapest-test plan.

candidate_matrix_revisions.effect: Made the gap segment the explicit control and the oc/o2o segments the only gating ones: the source prior is that the transmission sits in the gap, so tradability requires a surviving post-open effect.

Gate uses the W<0 vs W>=0 grouping and the 2022-06+ and 2024-01-08+ samples; the W<-3% grouping and the full sample are informational; the mirror (positive weekend) is not a separate candidate because the paper says it has no effect.
Added the equal-weight 10-coin signal next to BTC and ETH, 3 signal rows in total, no further tuning of windows or thresholds.
